caveats: All durations are illustrative planning workdays, not calculated from confirmed crew productivity or signed construction dates.
Footing prismatic gross pad volumes are as-drawn geometry envelopes; do not confuse with actual sloped casting volumes or approved BOQ.
MEP and fitout activities may be conditional scope, pending confirmed specifications/BOQ.
No site or structural engineering approvals, no actual work, no automatic external provider edits.
Only this Harisharan branch is modified; Narayani and shared scheduling kernel untouched.

Correction 2026-11-13: Owner chose Ø8 mm column stirrups/links. Prior Ø10 mm @100 mm column-stirrup claim was not verified in the project structural PDF; Ø10 mm bars in STR-10/11 are slab and staircase bars. No unapproved detail is issued for construction.
